Batch crawl stream produces expected Page and Complete events

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":2,\"ssrf\":{}}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"batch_urls\":[\"https://example.com/page1\",\"https://example.com/page2\",\"https://example.com/page3\"]}", BatchCrawlStreamRequest::class.java)
    engine.batchCrawlStream(req).collect { resultChunk ->
    println(resultChunk)
    }
}
```
